children.text: Through privacy-first AI and thoughtful design, we create software grounded in human sovereignty—protecting your privacy, respecting your attention, and supporting your self-knowledge.

children.text: The Alchemy

axes.fontFamily: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Symbol, Noto Color Emoji

children.text: Our name isn't accidental. Alchemy, at its essence, is about transformation—turning lead into gold, base matter into perfection.

axes.fontFamily: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Symbol, Noto Color Emoji

children.text: But the deepest alchemical tradition was never really about metals. It was about the self—the work of refining, clarifying, and discovering the gold that's already within.

axes.fontFamily: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Symbol, Noto Color Emoji

children.text: That's what we're building: technology for self-transformation. Tools that help you separate signal from noise, access buried wisdom, and become more fully yourself.

axes.fontFamily: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, Apple Color Emoji, Segoe UI Emoji, Segoe UI Symbol, Noto Color Emoji

children.text: We're not trying to change you. We're creating space for you to discover what's already there.
